channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 25 Aug: Harare mainly clear · high 25° / low 12°
item.description: Harare: high 25°, low 12° (mainly clear) · Bulawayo: high 24°, low 12° (overcast) · Mutare: high 22°, low 13° (light drizzle) · Gweru: high 24°, low 12° (overcast) · Masvingo: high 23°, low 14° (light drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 31°, low 17° (overcast) Tsumo yezuva: Gudo guru peta muswe vadiki vakutye.
